annotations: Kennedy Street NW, Georgia Avenue NW to about 3rd Street NW, Washington DC: 1 way, 0.64 mi, rated LTS 4 from DDOT's 2020 layer alone (formula 2). Proposed LTS 2.5, the level of the Kennedy St blocks either side on the same facts.

value.public_note: Kennedy St NW, Georgia Ave to 3rd St: 2 lanes, 25 mph, sharrows only, about 6,300 cars a day on the blocks either side, so 2.5, as they are. DDOT's 2020 layer says 4.

rows.reason: The owner, 2026-11-13: "Kennedy street has more signal priority and is probably overrated." Our level from the street's own facts: a two-lane (one each way) tertiary collector, posted 25 mph, shared-lane markings only, no count on this block; DC's count on the Kennedy St blocks either side is about 6,272 a day, and those blocks are rated 2.5 on the same facts (2 lanes, 25 mph, sharrows, about 6,300 a day). Our formula alone gives 2; the 4 on the map came only from DDOT's 2020 layer, with no reviewed row of ours. So 2.5, the street's level either side, which DDOT's 4 differs from.
